Config_GeneralText: General configuration settings will be added here.
Command_Config_Description: Opens the configuration menu. Usage: /marketeer config
Config_AutomationDelayToggle: Enable randomized delay between automated actions
Config_EnableDebugMode: Enable Debug mode (Verbose logging and developer tools)
Config_EnforceVendorPriceMinimum: Ignore undercuts below vendor sale price
Config_EnforceVendorPriceMinimum_Tooltip: Prevents Marketeer from alerting you to match prices that are lower than what NPCs will pay for the item. Unprofitable listings will trigger cancellation guidance instead.
